doc.title: Epic Breakdown - Story 2.16
doc.section: Epic 2: Core Gameplay - Story 2.16: Visual Polish for Gameplay
doc.snippet: Story 2.16 focuses on polishing visual effects during gameplay: smooth character movement animations, smooth event indicator animations, smooth «Затишок» bar updates, smooth timer countdown, and consistent visual style. Performance polish includes 60 FPS maintenance, no visual glitches, smooth CSS transitions, and GPU-accelerated transforms.

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: Use CSS transforms for animations (GPU-accelerated). Avoid layout thrashing (use `transform` not `top/left`). Use `requestAnimationFrame` for smooth 60 FPS. Batch state updates to minimize re-renders. Use `React.memo` for expensive components.

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: Character movement uses CSS `transform: translate()` for GPU-accelerated positioning. Movement is frame-rate independent using delta time. Character position is stored in component state and updated every frame.

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: Decision: Use CSS Modules for component styling. Rationale: Scoped styles prevent conflicts, good organization, no runtime overhead. Components use CSS Modules for scoped styles.

doc.title: UX Design Specification
doc.snippet: "Cozy Blackout" theme: Background (Dark Night #1a1f2e, Dark Grey #2d3442, Deep Blue #1e2740), Light Sources (Candle Yellow #f4a460, Warm Orange #ff8c42, Soft Glow #ffd700), UI/HUD (Light Text #ffffff, Accent Warm #ffd700). Event Priority Colors: Minor #64b5f6, Standard #fff176, Critical #ff8c42.

doc.title: UX Design Specification
doc.snippet: Font Families: System sans-serif stack. Type Scale: H1 28px/1.2/600, H2 24px/1.3/600, H3 20px/1.4/500, Body 16px/1.5/400, Small 14px/1.4/400, Tiny 12px/1.3/400.

doc.title: UX Design Specification
doc.snippet: Base Unit: 8px grid system. Spacing Scale: xs 4px, sm 8px, md 16px, lg 24px, xl 32px, 2xl 48px. Layout Grid: Game Screen flexible, UI Screens 12-column grid max-width 1200px, HUD absolute positioning with 8px padding.

doc.title: UX Design Specification
doc.snippet: All UI elements have soft rounded corners (8px border-radius consistent), subtle shadows behind panels and cards, consistent spacing (8px grid system), proper typography (system fonts, appropriate sizes). Visual effects are polished with smooth transitions, consistent animation timing, no visual glitches.

Use CSS transitions for animations (not JavaScript) for better performance.
Ensure frame-rate independent updates using delta time.
Use requestAnimationFrame for game loop (already implemented in Story 2.1).
Follow "Cozy Blackout" theme from UX design specification.
Use CSS variables for consistent colors across components.
Use consistent typography system (system sans-serif stack).
Maintain consistent border-radius (8px) for rounded corners.
Components use CSS Modules for styling.
Components read from GameContext for state (no local state duplication).
Smooth transitions use CSS transitions (not JavaScript animations).
Test performance in Chrome (primary target browser).
